vignette: 81-year-old woman with exertional dyspnea and angina (NYHA class III). Echocardiogram: severe aortic stenosis, valve area 0.7 cm2, mean gradient 48 mmHg, LVEF 55%. The planned valve system has FDA premarket approval and will be used for its FDA-approved indication. A cardiac surgeon and an interventional cardiologist each independently examined the patient face to face, evaluated suitability for SAVR, TAVR, or medical/palliative therapy, and documented their rationale in the shared record. Both will jointly participate in the procedure. The hospital has on-site heart valve surgery and interventional cardiology programs and a cardiovascular ICU; last year it performed 140 aortic valve replacements including 90 TAVRs, has 4 cardiac surgeons and 3 interventional cardiologists, and performs about 600 PCIs per year. The heart team and hospital participate in a prospective, national, audited TAVR registry that meets all of the registry requirements in this NCD.
